providers.notes: Preferred structured public abroad-stock source. Target-machine validation returned UK/Japan Xanax data successfully on 2026-08-21. Current Torn community stock tooling also uses this endpoint ahead of YATA. Normalize provider country codes, source timestamps, and provenance at the adapter boundary.
Structured public abroad-stock export retained as fallback. Target-machine validation observed HTTP 502 responses on 2026-08-21, so do not make YATA availability a single point of failure.

Use a local Torn API key when available. Prefer the lowest listing for immediate resale reference; retain the provider-reported average as secondary context. Item Market profitability applies the configured regular sales-tax percentage before margin gating.

An open-source YATA-backed travel planner documents a read-only snapshot history endpoint returning yata_ts, quantity, and cost. Travel Assistant has a bounded compatible importer, but no deployment host is assumed or enabled. Verify the specific host and its usage expectations before importing seed history.

Public documentation advertises metadata, current snapshots, historical metrics and forecast windows. Keep disabled for model/seed use until the live contract is verified from the user's machine. Forecast restock/stockout values are predictions and must not be imported as observed historical events.
Use as a clickable verification page. Do not create a page-scraping loop; only enable a structured adapter if a suitable bounded endpoint is identified and its usage remains appropriate.
